verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets users "use natural language with your chosen LLM client" (docs-17), and a probe confirms it is published (probe-4), so natural-language operation is a first-party capability. The evidence is a single thin line, however, and it does not show which operations the server exposes or whether it covers the Agentic Commerce APIs (cart, feed, ACP/UCP flows) rather than general Adyen resources. The shopper-facing agentic purchasing features are about third-party agents buying products, not about operating Adyen itself, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented scope of natural-language operations, coverage of Agentic Commerce endpoints, setup or usage depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
